title: Big Lots Recalls Tabletop Torches Due to Fire and Burn Hazards
summary: Once lit, the glass citronella table torches can flare up and emit burning lamp oil onto consumers and property, posing fire and burn hazards. Units: About 30,000.

title: Giant Bicycle Recalls XtC Bicycles and Seatposts Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The bicycle seatposts on the affected bicycles and the after-market seatposts can crack, posing a fall hazard. Units: About 200.

title: Holgate Toys Recalls Playmat Sets Due to Choking Hazard; Sold Exclusively at Wegmans Food Stores
summary: The wheels on the wooden vehicles can detach, posing a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 5,000.

title: LSI Recalls Wind Speed Sensors Due to Risk of Injury from Impact (Recall Alert)
summary: The sensor can fail to display an accurate data reading and cause crane operators and other users to incorrectly gauge wind conditions, posing a risk of injury from impact to the consumer. Units: About 100.

title: Toysmith Recalls Toy Light-Up Frogs and Ducks Due to Choking Hazard; Sold Exclusively at Cost Plus World Market
summary: The metal conductor pin on the bottom of the toys can come out, posing a choking hazard. Units: About 30,000.

title: Gerber Recalls Uppercut Knife and Sheath Sets Due to Laceration Hazard
summary: The Uppercut sheath does not hold the knife securely, allowing the knife to come out of the sheath unexpectedly, posing a laceration hazard. Units: About 2,900.

title: Sleepharmony Pink Youth Beds Recalled by Glideaway Due to Violation of Lead Paint Standard
summary: The surface paint on the pink-colored youth beds contains levels of lead that exceed the limits allowed by law. Units: About 1,850.

title: Cannondale Recalls Slice RS Bikes Due to Fall Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The brake plates can loosen and break, posing a fall hazard. Units: About 500.

title: HALO SleepSacks Wearable Blankets Recalled Due to Choking Hazard; Sold Exclusively at Babies R Us
summary: Petals from the floral embellishment on the blankets can detach, posing a choking hazard to infants. Units: About 27,000.

title: Apple Park Recalls Children’s Loungewear Due to Violation of Federal Flammability Standard
summary: The loungewear garments fail to meet children's sleepwear federal flammability standards which require sleepwear, including loungewear, to be either snug-fitting or flame resistant, posing a risk of burn injuries to children. Units: About 7,250.

title: Children’s Pajamas Recalled by Klever Kids Due to Violation of Federal Flammability Standard
summary: The pajamas fail to meet federal flammability standards for children's sleepwear, posing a risk of burn injuries to children. Units: About 7,000.

title: Wilton Industries Recalls Chefmate Tea Kettles Due to Burn Hazard; Sold Exclusively at Target
summary: Steam can travel up the handle, or water can spill from the spout, posing a burn hazard to the consumer. In addition, the leaking steam can cause the kettle to fail to whistle. If water completely evaporates from the kettle, the aluminum bottom can melt onto the stove and pose a burn hazard. Units:

title: Applica Consumer Products Reannounces Black & Decker Spacemaker Coffeemaker Recall Due to Injury Hazard; Units Sold After Recall
summary: The coffee pot handle can break, causing cuts and burns to the consumer. Units: About 641; (159,000 units were recalled in June 2012).

title: Char-Broil Recalls Patio Bistro Gas Grills Due to Burn Hazard
summary: The electronic ignition on the grill can ignite unexpectedly, posing a burn hazard. Units: About 69,300 in the U.S. and 1,900 in Canada.

title: IKEA Recalls Junior Beds Due to Laceration Hazard
summary: The metal rod connecting the guard rail to the bed frame can break in use, posing a laceration hazard. Units: About 22,000 in U.S. and 18,000 in Canada.

title: JP Boden Recalls Children's Sandals Due to Fall Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The cork sole can detach from the sandal and cause a child to trip and fall. Units: About 900.

title: Philips Lighting Recalls Endura and Ambient LED Bulbs Due to Shock Hazard
summary: A lead wire in the bulb's housing can have an improper fitting, which can electrify the entire lamp and pose a shock hazard. Units: About 99,000.

title: John Deere Recalls Compact Utility Tractors Due to Risk of Serious Injury or Death (Recall Alert)
summary: The spring locking pins in the rollover protective system (ROPS) can break and cause the ROPs to fail in the event of a rollover. This presents a risk of serious injury or death to the operator. Units: About 7,000.

title: LTD Commodities Recalls Microwave Crisper Pans Due to Fire Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The metal washer used to secure the knob to the lid can spark, posing a fire hazard to consumers. Units: About 18,220.

title: Husqvarna Recalls Closed-Course/Competition Off-Road Motorcycles Due to Crash Hazard
summary: The motorcycle's throttle cable can malfunction so the rider loses speed control, posing a crash hazard. Units: About 260.

title: Build-A-Bear Recalls Stuffed Animal Toy Due to Choking Hazard
summary: The stuffed animal's eye can detach, posing a choking hazard to young children. Units: 25,000 in the U.S. and 1,100 in Canada.

title: L.L.Bean Recalls Step Stools Due to Fall Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The step stools can slide or tip over, posing a fall hazard to consumers. Units: About 2,800.

title: Baby Jogger Recalls Car Seat Adaptors for Strollers Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The car seat adaptor support bars can fail, posing a fall hazard to children. Units: About 23,700 in the United States and 6,500 in Canada.

title: Vitamix Recalls 64-Ounce Low Profile Blender Container Due to Laceration Hazard
summary: The blade can break, creating a laceration hazard to consumers. Units: About 165,000 in the United States and an additional 4,300 in Canada.
